name: Browser Use
description: Company running millions of web agents, evolved from AWS Lambda to Unikraft micro-VM sandbox architecture

edges.quote: We started with browser-only agents on AWS Lambda, where each invocation is isolated, scaling is instant, and there are no secrets to worry about
Each agent gets its own Unikraft micro-VM, booting in under a second. We provision them via Unikraft Cloud's REST API on dedicated bare metal machines in AWS
We started with Pattern 1 and moved to Pattern 2
